{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.STM.TVar
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Aeson
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import GHC.Generics
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as BL
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

data Role = Admin | Editor | Viewer deriving (Show, Eq, Ord, Generic)
instance FromJSON Role
instance ToJSON Role

data User = User
  { userId   :: Text
  , userName :: Text
  , userRole :: Role
  } deriving (Show, Generic)
instance FromJSON User
instance ToJSON User

data Document = Document
  { docId      :: Text
  , docTitle   :: Text
  , docContent :: Text
  , docOwner   :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)
instance FromJSON Document
instance ToJSON Document

-- Global mutable state
userStore :: IORef (Map Text User)
userStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ Map.fromList
  [ ("u1", User "u1" "alice" Admin)
  , ("u2", User "u2" "bob" Editor)
  , ("u3", User "u3" "charlie" Viewer)
  ]
{-# NOINLINE userStore #-}

docStore :: IORef (Map Text Document)
docStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ Map.fromList
  [ ("d1", Document "d1" "Secret Plan" "Top secret content" "u1")
  ]
{-# NOINLINE docStore #-}

-- Authorization check: returns the user's role at time of check
authorizeUser :: Text -> IO (Maybe Role)
authorizeUser uid = do
  users <- readIORef userStore
  case Map.lookup uid users of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just u  -> return (Just (userRole u))

-- Check if role permits document modification
canModify :: Role -> Bool
canModify Admin  = True
canModify Editor = True
canModify Viewer = False

-- Demote a user's role (admin action)
demoteUser :: Text -> IO ()
demoteUser uid = do
  modifyIORef' userStore $ Map.adjust (\u -> u { userRole = Viewer }) uid

-- The critical operation: update document
-- Step 1: Check authorization (reads role from userStore)
-- Step 2: Perform the update (uses the authorization decision)
updateDocument :: Text -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text Document)
updateDocument uid docid newContent = do
  -- Phase 1: Authorization check
  roleResult <- authorizeUser uid
  case roleResult of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "User not found"
    Just role -> do
      -- TOCTOU window: between authorization check and actual write,
      -- the user's role could be demoted by a concurrent request.
      -- No re-validation occurs before the write.
      if canModify role
        then do
          -- Phase 2: Perform modification (no re-check)
          docs <- readIORef docStore
          case Map.lookup docid docs of
            Nothing -> return $ Left "Document not found"
            Just doc -> do
              let updated = doc { docContent = newContent }
              modifyIORef' docStore $ Map.insert docid updated
              return $ Right updated
        else return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"

-- Request handler
app :: Application
app req respond = do
  let path = pathInfo req
      method = requestMethod req
  case (method, path) of
    ("PUT", ["documents", docid]) -> do
      body <- strictRequestBody req
      let uid = maybe "" (T.pack . show) $
                lookup "X-User-Id" (requestHeaders req)
      result <- updateDocument uid docid (T.pack $ BL.unpack body)
      case result of
        Left err -> respond $ responseLBS status403 [] (BL.pack $ T.unpack err)
        Right doc -> respond $ responseLBS status200
          [("Content-Type", "application/json")] (encode doc)

    ("POST", ["admin", "demote", uid]) -> do
      demoteUser uid
      respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "User demoted"

    _ -> respond $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"

main :: IO ()
main = run 8080 app
